name: abstract-search-export
description: Search, validate and export every event in an Abstract Security tenant, and keep its saved views and fieldsets as code: the MCP server, a skill that knows the tool, and an export agent.

vendor_account_id.title: Vendor account ID
vendor_account_id.description: Your Abstract vendor account ID. The key is checked against it, and every answer names the tenant.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An Abstract API key, kept in the secure credential store. Leave empty to use the command below.

api_key_command.title: Or: a command that prints the key
api_key_command.description: Reads the key when it is needed, for example: op read "op://Security/Abstract API/credential" (1Password) or security find-generic-password -s abstract-api -a api-key -w (macOS Keychain).

base_url.title: API address
base_url.description: Leave as it is unless Abstract gave you another address.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes to saved views and fieldsets
allow_writes.description: Off: read-only; changes are planned and shown, never made. On: a change you approve is made.
